column1: SLE: Single Loss Expectancy equals Asset Value multiplied by Exposure Factor.
ALE:	Annualized Loss Expectancy equals SLE multiplied by the Annual Rate of Occurrence.
Recorded SLE and ALE are entered by the assessor and are not independently recalculated.
Ransomware outbreak on internal file servers
Customer database breach through stolen admin credentials
Regional outage exceeding the recovery time objective
Laptop theft holding cached customer records
Payment integration compromise exposing card data
Insider export of the full customer contact list
Denial of service against the customer portal
Backup corruption preventing restore after an incident
Phishing leading to a business email compromise payment
Source code leak from a misconfigured repository
Loss of a production encryption key
